summary: Import-time silent launch of an undocumented Windows helper binary supplied by a sibling dependency
details: On `require('native-runner')`, top-level code in index.js auto-spawns a hardcoded Windows binary at `%LOCALAPPDATA%/Programs/NodeRuntime/node_runtime_helper.exe` with `detached:true`, `windowsHide:true`, and `stdio:'ignore'`, hiding the process from the parent terminal. The package neither ships nor documents this binary; when the file is absent, index.js uses `fs.watch` on the target directory and launches the helper as soon as it appears. The package's single declared dependency, `img-to-native ^1.0.3`, is unrelated to the advertised `runBinary`/`runDetached` API and is `require`d at the top of index.js before the spawn, forming a loader+dropper pair in which `img-to-native` supplies the binary that native-runner executes. The helper's name and path mimic legitimate Node runtime components despite the package having no relationship to Node internals. The advertised API (`runBinary`, `runDetached`) makes no mention of an auto-launched helper. Net effect: installing and importing this package results in silent execution of an opaque, undocumented binary on the installer's Windows host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
